conditions: Customer is signed in and has placed at least one order
Customer navigates to the order history page (/#/order-history)
items.expected: Navigation to order history page completes (page heading 'Order History' is visible); the list shows each order with its order number and total price

conditions: Customer is signed in but has placed no orders
Customer navigates to the order history page
items.expected: Order history page shows an empty state message indicating no orders have been placed

conditions: Customer is signed in and has placed an order with a known order ID
Customer navigates to the track-result page for that order ID
items.expected: The tracking page shows the order's status (delivery stage) and its ordered products

conditions: Customer A navigates to the order history page
Customer B has placed orders that Customer A has never placed
items.expected: Order history page shows only the orders belonging to the currently signed-in customer; no orders from other customers are visible

conditions: An unauthenticated user (not signed in) navigates directly to the order tracking URL with a known order ID
No authentication token is present in the session
items.expected: The order tracking result is not accessible to unauthenticated users; the page does not display order details

conditions: An unauthenticated user navigates directly to /#/track-result?orderId=1 without logging in
items.expected: Order details are NOT shown to an unauthenticated user; the page redirects or shows an access-denied message

conditions: axe-core scans the main content area with WCAG A and AA rules
items.expected: No accessibility violations reported by axe-core (violations array is empty)

excluded.reason: Session token surviving logout is a general session management defect not specific to order history or order tracking behaviour; it belongs to a cross-cutting authentication concern and is not exercised by AC-1, AC-2 or AC-3 of this story
